description: Defines an abstract class NamedIndexingService responsible for processing indexing tasks, managing index profiles, and handling document indexing within the OrchardCore indexing system.

classes.name: NamedIndexingService
classes.description: An abstract base class for managing indexing operations, including processing index profiles, batching tasks, and invoking document handlers.

methods.name: ProcessRecordsForAllIndexesAsync
methods.description: Processes all index profiles of the specified type asynchronously.

methods.name: ProcessRecordsAsync
methods.description: Processes specific index profiles based on provided index IDs.

methods.name: ProcessRecordsAsync
methods.description: Internal method that processes a collection of index profiles, managing index tasks and document updates.

methods.name: GetBuildDocumentIndexAsync
methods.description: Abstract method to build the document index context for a given index profile and task.

methods.name: ShouldTrackDocumentAsync
methods.description: Virtual method to determine if a document should be tracked for indexing.

methods.name: BeforeProcessingTasksAsync
methods.description: Virtual method invoked before processing a batch of indexing tasks.
